column3: attachment chips enter with .im-arrive and exit through createPresence with data-closing in composer.css: opacity 0, scale(--arrive-from), --dur-dialog-exit (70% of --dur-arrive), --ease-out; chips are keyed by id
column4: the motion file has no exit for .im-arrive; .im-tab[data-closing] fits but carries tab-only transitions; keying by id stops upload progress from remounting (and re-animating) a chip; a keyboard remove drops the chip at once through createPresence
column5: headless Chromium: chip mounted with data-closing ~150ms then unmounted
